name: Devilish Girlfriend
overview:
On the day when Anna was shooting wedding photographs with her fiancé, Samuel, he collapsed before her eyes, caught in a deadly traffic accident. Satan appears before Anna the moment she offers her desperate prayer in despair.

"Are you willing to do anything?"

The fiancé comes alive, but Anna is now possessed by Satan. Her relationship with the Devil becomes dangerously closer, forging a dangerous relationship!

"Our meeting was not a coincidence?" Will Anna be able to reclaim her love and normal life again?
